### Workflow entry: urlshort-slice-delegated-b@1 step requirements

Entry step: requirements (requirements)

Root objective: Mission 02-brownfield, slice 04-audit-columns (OPR.99.0.3.4, tier low, delegated plan-lock to the lead under D11, wave w2 per wave map v4; lane B: dev2-agent builds, qa2-agent QA and proof judge, review2-agent review). Origin: the human's audit-column decision (operator qitem-20261003175330-fb054f2f, verbatim in missions/02-brownfield/NOTES.md section 2 at 18:00Z): every table carries created_at and updated_at (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at maintained on every write) plus created_by and updated_by wherever an actor exists; docs/guidance/databases.md sections 2 and 8. This slice covers link and audit_log only (click and user_agent_class are 02-click-retention's V3). Requirements: the audit-column policy for link and audit_log; NFR-X2 (versioned expand migration with a written rollback); FR-13 (existing links, redirects, statistics and the audit read behave exactly as before); NFR-A2 (audit_log stays append-only: no update path added, updated_at equals created_at on every audit row); M1 M2. Pattern to follow: ADR-0020 (02-click-retention, f044cbe): database-clock defaults, constant or request actors, backfill of existing rows, one expand migration with a written rollback. Assume V4, after 02-click-retention's V3; the plan-lock confirms the number. BROWNFIELD: design writes impact-analysis.md over link/ and audit/ (V1, the repositories, the audit writer) before design.md. 01-audit-read (w1, in implement) adds GET /api/audit over audit/: read its locked SPEC 7b753b7 and design 4eb1eb4 and say whether the new columns are exposed by the audit read (default: not, no contract change). Territory: link/ and audit/ (main, unit, functional) and db/migration/; not click/, web/, docs/api/openapi.json. SCHEDULE: requirements and design run now; the lead holds this slice's plan-lock gate until both w1 slices are merged, and the plan-lock requires impact-analysis.md re-checked against the merged main. The worktree is created at plan-lock, from the merged main. Requirements-seat order: 05-ci-cd, then this slice, then 03-dogfood-fix. Command hygiene: Edit tool for documents, single plain commands, no sed -i, perl -i, shell variables or cd.

Step objective: Write the slice SPEC.md: user stories, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, business rules, scope, ambiguity log, proof contract. Park a real ambiguity on the human; otherwise record safe defaults.
